title: unavailable state
name: Unavailable state
rule: Show when a menu item is unavailable (typically dimmed); if every item is unavailable, keep the menu itself openable.
pass_when: Unavailable items are shown as unavailable (typically dimmed); if all items are unavailable, the menu still opens.
fail_when: Unavailable items are omitted with no unavailable state, or the menu cannot be opened when every item is unavailable.
overview: Unavailable menu items stay visible and dimmed; empty menus still open.
apply_when: Menu commands can be temporarily unavailable in the current context.
not_when: Permanently removed features that should leave the menu entirely.
agent_hint: Dim unavailable items; keep the menu openable even if every item is dimmed.
description: Show unavailable menu items in an unavailable state—typically dimmed—so people still learn what exists in the menu. If every item is unavailable, the menu itself should still open rather than vanishing. Omitting items with no unavailable state, or blocking the menu entirely, hides structure and confuses discovery. Remove only features that are gone for good; temporary unavailability should stay visible and dimmed.
